name: Stolen Voices
start_toast: The singing did not stop at the source. It followed you up, and it has been listening to how your people talk.
summary: Since the source, the Choir speaks to you in the Shards in your companions' voices, with their own words. It is courting. Three times it will ask you down.

voice_1.summary: Something in the Shards is speaking in a voice you know.

voice_2.summary: It has more of their words than you thought.

voice_3.summary: The third time it will ask outright.

courted.summary: The Choir has spoken in three borrowed voices. It has your measure now, and you have its.
